subject: The 2AM tweak that unlocks +200%
preview_text: A quiet, one-time setup that disappears after you connect headphones. Power users only.
body_paragraphs: At 2AM, I rebuilt the slider logic. Not for the crowd — for the one person who just wants the volume up and the world out. That's you. You downloaded this because the free version got in your way. I saw the pattern: open app, skip ad, boost, forget. Every time, a tiny interruption. Over months, it adds up.

Here's the shortcut nobody mentions: Go to Settings > Auto-apply on headphone connect. Set it once. Then forget the app exists. Every time you plug in headphones — Spotify, YouTube, a game — the boost is there. No tap. No ad. No notification. The app becomes invisible. That's the point.

This isn't a hack. It's the original design. The slider and the EQ are the only things on screen. Set your level. Connect your cans. Done. It stays out of your way until you want it back. Quiet utility. Like a good tool should feel.

Open the app. Tap the gear icon. Toggle 'Auto-apply on headphone connect.' That's it. You're now a power user. P.S. — If you want the full +200% boost without even thinking about it, Premium unlocks system-wide persistence. Same quiet. No limits.
